instruction: In pylint/checkers/refactoring/refactoring_checker.py, make the stop-iteration-return message (R1708) node-scoped: end its message tuple with the options element {"scope": WarningScope.NODE}, on its own line after the message text. Import WarningScope from pylint.constants, in the place the module's sorted imports put it.

require.match: replaced by a simple return statement",\n\s+\{"scope": WarningScope\.NODE\},
